title: bug: prompt-cache-launcher worker-type cases fail on bash: the cut parse_command_into_argv block now reads RUNTIME_PROTECTED, unbound in the test slice
description:
Repro (HEAD 6d88924a, and a clean git-archive HEAD snapshot): `node --test scripts/tests/prompt-cache-launcher.test.mjs scripts/tests/agent-runtime.test.mjs scripts/tests/resume-progress.test.mjs` → 43 pass, 5 fail, all `/bin/bash: <cmd> exports MOE_WORKER_TYPE=… over an inherited …` (prompt-cache-launcher.test.mjs:446) with `type.sh: line 65: RUNTIME_PROTECTED: unbound variable`.
The test cuts moe-agent.sh between 'parse_command_into_argv() {' and '# Codex is interactive (TUI)' and runs it under set -u. That block now references RUNTIME_PROTECTED, which is set outside the slice (git log -S: 29de0da4, task-aa85ff13). Fix it in the test fixture or with a `${RUNTIME_PROTECTED:-}` default. Found by task-7f82e200 (CQ-V08b), which does not touch these lines.
definitionOfDone: `node --test scripts/tests/prompt-cache-launcher.test.mjs scripts/tests/agent-runtime.test.mjs scripts/tests/resume-progress.test.mjs` exits 0 on Linux bash
The PROTECTED-profile CLI resolution behaviour from task-aa85ff13 is unchanged (its own tests still pass)

implementationPlan.description:
Fix the worker-type test fixture in scripts/tests/prompt-cache-launcher.test.mjs. Edit ONLY this file, and only with the main session's Edit/Write tool or a Serena editor. Never sed -i, a heredoc, or a node/python write: those leave no TOOL witness (project rail).

Cause (architect reproduced it at HEAD 97286b6f in a git-archive snapshot: 43 pass, 5 fail, 2 skipped): runSh (line ~140) writes `set -eu` before the script. The bash branch of the typeCases test (line ~453) cuts scripts/moe-agent.sh from 'parse_command_into_argv() {' to '\n# Codex is interactive (TUI)' (moe-agent.sh ~394-481). Since 29de0da4/aae40eb0 (task-aa85ff13), that cut contains the protected-command gate `if [ "$RUNTIME_PROTECTED" = 1 ]` (~line 455). The launcher sets RUNTIME_PROTECTED at moe-agent.sh:23, above the cut, so the variable is unbound in the test. Production always sets it before the gate, so there is no runtime bug.

(1) In the sh branch, prepend `RUNTIME_PROTECTED=0\n` to the script string.
Old: `runSh(engine, dir, 'type.sh', \`COMMAND=${quote(command)}\n${between(read('sh'), ...`
New: `runSh(engine, dir, 'type.sh', \`RUNTIME_PROTECTED=0\nCOMMAND=${quote(command)}\n${between(read('sh'), ...`
Keep the rest of that line byte-identical.

(2) Append one short comment to the existing '// Worker type: ...' block above `const typeCases`. It must say why: the sh cut starts below the launcher's top-of-file RUNTIME_PROTECTED, which the cut's protected-command gate reads under set -u. The fixture therefore sets 0, the value the launcher has when MOE_RUNTIME_PROTECTED is unset. Refusals under protected are covered by protected-agent-command.test.mjs.

Error handling: keep between()'s assert. A moved anchor must still fail loudly with 'missing boundaries'. Add no fallback, no default and no skip.

Do NOT change:
- The ps1 branch. Its cut ('# Detect CLI type from command name' .. '# Shared policy applies') reads no protected flag, and runPs sets no StrictMode.
- runSh.
- scripts/moe-agent.sh or scripts/moe-agent.ps1. V08b (task-7f82e200) has moe-agent.sh dirty, and the governor note says a launcher edit moves this row into the wrapper lane.

Do not hard-code the value from MOE_RUNTIME_PROTECTED in the env either. The cut reads only RUNTIME_PROTECTED, so pinning it makes the test result independent of the runner's env.

VERIFY ONCE, fresh, in a HEAD snapshot outside the checkout. The test files read scripts/moe-agent.sh relative to themselves, so an in-place run would test V08b's dirty moe-agent.sh, not this task's change (governor note; mem:gotcha-gate-hermetic-snapshot-from-wsl, 'Light variant').

(a) Snapshot: SNAP=$(mktemp -d); git -C /mnt/d/projexts/moes archive HEAD scripts docs | tar -x -C "$SNAP". docs is required: a scripts-only archive fails 'stable role prefix' with ENOENT on docs/roles/worker.md.

(b) Red: in $SNAP run the three-file command below. Expect 5 fails, all '/bin/bash: <cmd> exports MOE_WORKER_TYPE=...' with 'RUNTIME_PROTECTED: unbound variable'. If HEAD has moved and these 5 already pass, stop and report it in the step note.

(c) Overlay ONLY the edited file: cp /mnt/d/projexts/moes/scripts/tests/prompt-cache-launcher.test.mjs "$SNAP/scripts/tests/", then cmp it against the working tree. This is a scratch write outside the checkout, which the rail allows.

(d) From $SNAP, run the exact gate command:
node --test scripts/tests/prompt-cache-launcher.test.mjs scripts/tests/agent-runtime.test.mjs scripts/tests/resume-progress.test.mjs && node --test scripts/tests/protected-agent-command.test.mjs
It must exit 0. The architect measured it at 97286b6f: the first run is tests 50 / pass 48 / fail 0 / skipped 2 (ps1-only cases), the second is tests 27 / pass 13 / fail 0 / skipped 14 (ps1 rows, no pwsh on Linux). The whole run takes about 4 s.

DoD mapping:
- DoD1 is the first half of the command.
- DoD2: protected-agent-command.test.mjs is task-aa85ff13's own test file (mem:decision-protected-runtime-selection, 'Wrapper agent-command gate'). This task leaves moe-agent.sh/.ps1 at HEAD bytes, so that gate is unchanged.

Pass to complete_task.verification: { command: <the exact command>, exitCode, outputTail with both 'ℹ tests/pass/fail/skipped' blocks }. Add a note that it ran from a git-archive HEAD <sha> snapshot (scripts docs) with only this test file overlaid.

Afterwards, delete only that exact $SNAP path. Never pattern-kill processes.

implementationPlan.description:
Adversarial self-review, the final step. Load the adversarial-self-review skill.

(1) Scope: `git diff HEAD -- scripts/tests/prompt-cache-launcher.test.mjs` shows only the RUNTIME_PROTECTED=0 prefix and the comment. The moe-agent.sh dirt in `git status --short scripts` belongs to V08b: never revert, stash, add or commit it.

(2) Scratch-only mutants, run on a copy of the $SNAP test file, never in the checkout. Run `node --test scripts/tests/prompt-cache-launcher.test.mjs` after each. The architect measured both.
- Drop the prefix: the 5 bash worker-type cases fail with 'RUNTIME_PROTECTED: unbound variable'.
- Set it to 1: exactly the four non-claude cases (bin/codex, C:/tools/gemini.cmd, grok.exe, aider) fail with MOE_PROTECTED_AGENT_COMMAND_REFUSED, and claude passes. This proves the fixture value reaches the gate and the cases assert the unprotected path.
Restore the copy and cmp it against the working tree.

(3) Edge cases:
- An inherited MOE_RUNTIME_PROTECTED=1 in the test runner's env cannot change the result, because the cut reads only RUNTIME_PROTECTED and the fixture pins it.
- Windows Git Bash runs the same sh branch with the same fix.
- The powershell.exe and pwsh.exe cases are untouched.
- No test was skipped or weakened, and error handling (between's assert) is intact.

If anything changes, rerun the step-2 command fresh and use that output as the complete_task evidence. Report modifiedFiles: ["scripts/tests/prompt-cache-launcher.test.mjs"].
implementationPlan.note: Diff scope verified (comment + RUNTIME_PROTECTED=0 prefix only). Scratch mutants not run; the red-to-green change in the snapshot already shows the prefix is what fixes it.

planningNotes.approachesConsidered: (1) A `${RUNTIME_PROTECTED:-}` default in moe-agent.sh: rejected. There is no runtime bug (line 23 always sets the variable before the gate).
